name: qwilr
label: Qwilr
description: Create beautiful, interactive sales documents and proposals with Qwilr. Automate page creation, track views, and handle acceptance events.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
1. Go to your Qwilr account settings.
    2. Navigate to API Settings.
    3. Copy your access token.

create_page.label: Create Page
create_page.description: Creates a new Qwilr page from saved blocks or template.

templateId.label: Template ID
templateId.description: ID of the template to use for the page

name.label: Page Name
name.description: Title of the page, visible as the browser page title

published.label: Publish Page
published.description: Whether the page is publicly available; false means the page will be in Draft status

ownerId.label: Owner ID
ownerId.description: ID of the user that should own the page. If not specified, the owner of the access token will be the owner of the page.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The tags for your page. Tags are case-sensitive.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Data you provide, that will be returned as part of all Webhooks.

substitutions.label: Substitutions
substitutions.description: Mapping of token API reference keys to substitution values used throughout the page.

acceptSettings.label: Accept Settings
acceptSettings.description: Configures settings for the accept block in the template being used. Only relevant if you have an accept block.
